metadata.description: Code, hash-locked experiment manifests, audited metric tables, figure source data, manuscript sources and tests for a controlled simulation study of routing-aware federated intrusion detection (UNSW-NB15, CICIoT2023): delivery reliability versus participation fairness, median/MAD filtering under sign-flip attackers, surrogate imputation, a pre-registered negative result for a minimum-genuine-update guard, and an audited threshold/metric evaluation. Validation-only protocol; the locked final-test files are not included and were not used for modelling. Datasets are public and not redistributed. The Gaussian budget is a diagnostic value, not a differential-privacy guarantee. Raw run folders (checkpoints) are not part of this record unless the authors decide otherwise.
